connection.blocked.claude.zh: 这一步要用 Claude，你的 Claude API 密钥还没连上。
connection.blocked.claude.en: This step needs Claude, and your Claude API key isn’t connected yet.

connection.blocked.openai.zh: 这一步要用 OpenAI 处理图片，你的 OpenAI API 密钥还没连上。
connection.blocked.openai.en: This step uses OpenAI for images, and your OpenAI API key isn’t connected yet.

connection.blocked.gemini.zh: 这个浏览器不支持语音识别，要用 Gemini 转写。你的 Gemini API 密钥还没连上。
connection.blocked.gemini.en: This browser can’t recognise speech, so voice input needs Gemini. Your Gemini API key isn’t connected yet.

connection.degraded.gemini.zh: 正在用浏览器自带的语音识别。连上 Gemini，转写更准。
connection.degraded.gemini.en: Using your browser’s speech recognition. Connect Gemini for more accurate transcripts.

connection.key-help.en: How do I get a key?

connection.get-key.zh: 在 {site} 创建 {provider} API 密钥

connection.paste-key.zh: 复制密钥，粘贴到上面的输入框，再点「连接」。
connection.paste-key.en: Copy the key, paste it into the field above, then select Connect.

connection.key-stored.zh: 密钥只存在这个浏览器里，调用 {provider} 时直接发给它，不经过别处，也不会导出。
connection.key-stored.en: The key stays in this browser. It goes straight to {provider} when Lumi calls it, nowhere else, and is never exported.

connection.key-not-stored.zh: 双击打开时不会保存密钥，关掉页面后要重新填。
connection.key-not-stored.en: Opened as a file, Lumi doesn’t save the key, so you’ll enter it again next time.

help.connect-provider.q.zh: 怎么填 API 密钥，怎么知道连上了？
help.connect-provider.q.en: How do I add my API keys, and how do I know they work?

help.connect-provider.a.zh: Lumi 用你自己的 API 密钥调用 AI 服务，每个服务一把。点下面的服务名，会跳到设置里它那一行，输入框旁边就有拿密钥的步骤。连上后，那一行会显示「已连接」。
help.connect-provider.a.en: Lumi calls AI services with your own API keys, one key per service. Select a service below to jump to its row in Settings. The steps to get a key are right beside the field. Once it’s connected, the row shows Connected.

help.connect-provider.stored.zh: 密钥只存在这个浏览器里，调用时直接发给对应的服务，不经过别处，也不会导出。
help.connect-provider.stored.en: Keys stay in this browser. Each one goes straight to its own service when Lumi calls it, nowhere else, and is never exported.

help.connect-provider.not-stored.zh: 双击打开时不会保存密钥，关掉页面后要重新填。
help.connect-provider.not-stored.en: Opened as a file, Lumi doesn’t save keys, so you’ll enter them again next time.

settings.keys-note.zh: 用你自己的 API 密钥。密钥只存在这个浏览器里，调用时直接发给对应的服务，不经过别处，也不会导出。
settings.keys-note.en: Bring your own API keys. They stay in this browser, go straight to each service when Lumi calls it, and are never exported.
